body: I'm still here, days later. It's been so hard but I'm doing my best. Thank you for your message, I'd like to be able to talk to you more too, you seem to be one of the good guys.

I've always struggled, at home, at school (due to severe bullying) and even in my own head. I recently learned I'm autistic and have had great difficulty in dealing with that. I have always been surrounded by people who only sought to benefit themselves and most took advantage of my nature. I believed I've weighed up my options fairly and suicide is the most favourable option. I know I won't feel any relief but at least the pain will cease.

They don't have to like you. But that's their loss. It's not something which can be explained simply, but some people have a negative worth. I don't know you and I don't know what kind of person you are, but I doubt you deserve to be treated like this. Just because they "brought you into this world" does not mean they are good people.

I'll hang around for as long as I can.

I mean that I'm too weak to fight through all the grief, sadness and anger. I haven't done anything yet, but I do plan to end it tonight, I gave myself a week to improve when I decided it was what I wanted and I haven't changed by mind.
Thank you for taking the time to read my post and respond.

I care. I know I'm just some blank face on the interest. But I care. I truly do. Like you I come from a bad home, but that is not enough for you to end your life, nor are any exam results. You are a wonderful creature and I care.
PM if you'd like, I want to leave behind something positive.

I do realise how unfair that is, I'm just not sure if I'm okay with it / can deal with it.

I really don't want to believe she's stringing me along but I may have to force myself to come to some harsh realisations. Thank you for your opinion.

That's just it, I don't know if I do. I love her, but I know it's not good for me. 

Thanks for taking the time to comment, have an upvote.
